title: Your neighborhood, hands on
summary: Drop into the street, look around freely, and carry your own items to a new spot.
changes: Enter Street view by dragging the person onto a highlighted road.
Look around with your mouse while the cursor is captured. Escape releases it; City view takes you back.
Look directly at your own items to highlight them. Double-click to pick up, walk to another spot, and double-click again to place.
Rotate held items with R and cancel with Escape. Invalid spots are marked in red, and owned items move for free.
Spend bricks on corner shops, neighbors, planters, benches, lamps, trees, and sculptures. New purchases charge only when placed.
Use touch swipes, walking arrows, and double-taps to explore and move items on mobile.
